Tests trace T-E01-01 and the discovery portion of T-E01-02 to R01/R06 and SYSTEM invariants. They cover the full runtime declaration inventory, fake counterparts, rollback/savepoints including queued events, immutable snapshots/maps, full command identities/intents, generations, private publication rejection, revocation controls, clock segments, missing configuration, nonfinite/duplicate input and typed evaluator failure isolation. Source UI copy is schema-validated before and after a cosmetic scratch label edit. Numerical unit/time/hash cases have independent expectations; the ID golden was checked with shasum.

The JavaScript toolchain declares Node 22.23.4 through package.json devEngines.runtime with onFail download. pnpm-lock.yaml records the exact runtime and platform archive checksums. pnpm installs it locally and supplies it to scripts and exec commands, as specified in [pnpm runtime documentation](https://pnpm.io/package_json#devenginesruntime).

Three new regression cases in hub/tests/contracts/test_sha_guard.py prove the declaration matches the locked runtime and checksums, and both TypeScript checking and the generator CLI work with a deliberately failing node executable first on PATH. Both command cases failed with exit 97 before the fix. Their subprocesses are offline and bounded by the existing 300-second build ceiling.

Both generators run twice into temporary outputs and compare bytes. A fresh Python process verifies framework-free kernel imports. The source mypy gate covers 25 files. Ruff formatting covers 28 files. Import-linter analyzes 150 files and keeps the installed kernel contract; AST checks additionally enforce feature restrictions and inspect TYPE_CHECKING imports and I/O through allowed libraries.

All nine required commands below ran from the repository root and returned zero with the ordinary inherited PATH. No shell-specific Node override is needed. The failing Homebrew Node 26 binary is bypassed by the declared project runtime. No global software was changed. A normal pnpm frozen install also passed its supply-chain policy check.

A supplementary offline frozen-install probe failed because pnpm lacked cached js-levenshtein supply-chain metadata. The subsequent normal frozen install passed verification; offline reinstallation was not rechecked. Product code and the owned tests make no network calls. Wheel inspection and supplemental test mypy were not rerun during this repair.

The repair changes package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and hub/tests/contracts/test_sha_guard.py, plus this required report. Existing foundation mechanisms and interface signatures are unchanged. Generation gates republish their allocated outputs through the existing pipeline.

Upstream diagnostics remain visible. datamodel-code-generator warns that AwareDatetime cannot preserve a regex. The schema-derived validator at hub/src/crew_health/contracts_gen/build.py:213 restores the exact instant pattern; its regression rejects non-Z input. openapi-typescript gives duplicate example component names deterministic distinct names. Ruff, mypy and import-linter have no outstanding failures or warnings.

These are existing descriptor ceilings from docs/tdd/E01.md:574 and docs/SYSTEM.md:1505, not a new settings source. Missing or wrong supplied settings fail. Pure parsers enforce the fixed maximum ceilings; runtime boundaries must also apply their configured lower limits.

|---|---|
| storage.max_rows; storage.max_statement_bytes | 1..1000; 1..1048576 bytes |
| event_bus.max_events; events.max_subscribers | 1..1024; 1..128 |
| commands.max_bytes; commands.max_depth; commands.cache_entries | 1..8388608 bytes; 1..64; 1..10000 |
| clock.max_uncertainty_ms; clock.future_tolerance_ms; clock.hlc_future_ms | 0..60000 ms |
| clock.hlc_logical_max; clock.history_page_size | 1..2147483647; 1..200 |

| evaluation.page_size; evaluation.retry_max | 1..200; 0..10 |
| sync.pending_max; sync.page_entries | 1..10000; 1..200 |
| private.max_entry_bytes; private.recovery_batch; private.max_versions | 20000000..33554432 bytes; 1..200; 1..10000 |
| registry.max_modules; registry.max_ports; registry.max_hooks | 1..128; 1..1024 ports/hooks |
| registry.startup_timeout_ms | 1..300000 ms; build subprocesses use the 300-second ceiling |
